_why: Pages that draw their own list or editor for a family of configured things (planning#440 step 6, D1013). A family is a contiguous block that its U packet deletes with the page. The list only shrinks.

oidc.packages/addon-admin-ui/src/pages/system: bespoke connection list over oidc-connections CRUD; P6c (U) moves it to InstancesTable and deletes the page

storage.packages/addon-admin-ui/src/pages/system: bespoke location list over storage.upsertLocation / deleteLocation; P6d (U) moves it to InstancesTable
storage.packages/addon-admin-ui/src/components/s: bespoke create wizard over storage.upsertLocation; P6d (U) moves it to InstanceCreateDialog
bespoke editor over storage.upsertLocation; P6d (U) moves it to InstanceEditorDialog
storage.packages/addon-admin-ui/src/components/p: second location list (mode, discard) over storage upsert / delete; P6d (U) folds it into the instances lead slot
